content_note: Every rule here is intent-only: a name, an id and a logic line that names the detections the rule would join. There is no query, schedule, severity or alert mapping, so nothing in this file can be imported into a tenant as-is. Author the rule in the XSIAM console from the logic line.

rules.logic: Fires when abioc `Suspicious secrets dump activity` and abioc `AWS SSM parameters retrieval` both observe the same user_identity_arn and source_ip_address within a 15-minute window, stitching the Secrets Manager dump and the SSM Parameter Store retrieval into one credential-harvesting incident (raises incident severity above either ABIOC alone).
rules.name: SIM-CDR-020 — credential & secret harvesting behavioral chain
